info.name: Query Audits Query Audits API API
Get the results of a search using the `search_uuid`.

params.name: next_page_token
params.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results returned.

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves the results of a search using the `search_uuid` provided by the /search endpoint. The results are paginated and can be retrieved using the `next_page_token` provided in the response.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip.

params.name: from_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended before this time will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Default is 24 hours ago.

params.name: to_date_time
params.description: Queries that ended after this time will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in valid RFC3339 format. Default is now.

params.name: executing_role
params.description: The role that executed the query. Case-insensitive.

params.name: executing_user
params.description: The user that executed the query. Case-insensitive.

params.name: query_id
params.description: The ID of the query. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_tag_name
params.description: The policy tag name to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_tag_value
params.description: The policy tag value to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_column_database_name
params.description: The policy column database name to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_column_schema_name
params.description: The policy column schema name to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_column_table_name
params.description: The policy column table name to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: policy_column_name
params.description: The policy column name to filter by. Case-insensitive.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The order by clause for the query. Case-insensitive.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The column to sort by. Case-insensitive.

items.docs:
This endpoint triggers a search for query audits. Chaining query parameter filters as `AND` operations.
The `search_uuid` that is returned expires after 30 days.
